en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large fortified complex on a hill above trees. The ensemble includes a long, steep‑roofed Gothic‑style building with many small gabled dormers and pointed arch windows, a tall church spire, a richly ornamented central roof with pinnacles, and curtain walls with battlements and a prominent square gate tower on the right. The foreground is a rough, cultivated field and dense trees; the sky is blank and overexposed. No printed captions or handwriting are visible on the image side.
